title: City Cruises Philadelphia: Signature Buffet Lunch Cruise
includes: Unlimited coffee, hot tea, iced tea and water
Private outdoor table with amazing views of the Philadelphia skyline
A two-hour cruise on the Delaware River
Delicious lunch buffet with freshly prepared entrees, salads and desserts (view menu)
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Infants aged 2 years and under are free of charge (meal not included).
Attire: We encourage casual attire that is informal and comfortable, (khakis, nice jeans, dresses, casual button-ups/blouses).
Seating is only guaranteed together for the number of tickets confirmed on this voucher. Reservations may not be combined.
Boarding begins 30 minutes prior to departure. Guests must arrive early, as late arrivals will likely miss the boat.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Grab the family, your group of friends, or colleagues and experience the city in a new way aboard the Spirit of Philadelphia! Enjoy a chef-prepared lunch buffet, fun deck games, a narrated tour and DJ entertainment. See spectacular views of the Philadelphia skyline and waterfront landmarks from the interior dining decks and exterior rooftop lounge!

Departing from Penn's Landing, a lunch cruise with City Cruises is the perfect way to spend a relaxing afternoon on the water.
